note: N1 (owner authorisation 2026-10-21): general vocabulary of teaching-table column headers. Built from the headers of the development documents only (translated documents of air fryers, air purifiers, coffee and dishwashers); no category, product or food word. A header's role is the role of the last cue word of its first cued segment (the head of the header phrase); a negation or prohibition word anywhere makes it a caveat. Roles and link kinds carry relevance only: never a cause, a demonstrated result or a ranking input.
noteReformulations: dev-it1 (2026-10-21, development rows only): a slash without spaces joins alternative words inside one phrase; a generic head (requirement, needed) yields to an earlier cue of its segment; 'establish' removed (a verb, not a column noun); a situation links on only when its row has no need column (the need interprets it: relevant_to targets a property, not a need), and the situation stays a participant; a condition or caveat qualifies the link that spans it, else the row's first link.

dev-it2 (2026-10-21, development rows only): a need or generic head modified by a technical word (technical, physical, measurable, evaluable, quantitative, engineering) denotes a criterion (property): 'technical requirements', 'physical/evaluable needs' (the D1 adjudication classified such headers as criteria independently).

dev-it3 (2026-10-21, development rows only; last reformulation, then frozen): a header that coordinates a caveat with another role ('Likely mechanism / limitation', 'Evidence or conditional rejection trigger') is read as a caveat: a column mixing a warning with other content qualifies links and asserts none of its own (cautious reading); 'reject', 'rejection' added to the caveat cues.
